title: Charging Window Missed Before Departure
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:charge
| eval hours_to_departure=round((scheduled_departure_ts-_time)/3600,1)
| where hours_to_departure>=0 AND hours_to_departure<=2
| stats latest(battery_pct) as battery_pct, latest(charge_limit_pct) as limit_pct by vin scheduled_departure_ts
| where battery_pct<limit_pct-10
| sort battery_pct
description: Checks the final couple of hours before scheduled departure and finds the mornings where charging is clearly not on track to hit the planned limit.
value: A smart departure schedule is only useful if the pack is actually ready when you leave; this catches the miss while there is still time to react.
implementation: Ingest charge telemetry with scheduled departure and charge-limit values; alert if the battery is too far below target near departure time.
visualization: Table of departures at risk of leaving under target state of charge.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when your car is getting close to departure time and still looks too undercharged to hit the goal you set.
